svg.title: Three sketches of electric field lines, drawn solid with arrows, and equipotentials, drawn dashed. Left: a positive point charge with eight field lines pointing radially outwards and three concentric circular equipotentials at equal steps of potential; the gaps between the circles grow with distance. Centre: a positive charge on the left and a negative charge of equal size on the right. Field lines curve from the positive charge to the negative one. Closed equipotential loops surround each charge, and a straight vertical equipotential, the zero of potential, runs halfway between them. Right: two parallel plates, positive on top and negative below, with straight, equally spaced field lines pointing down between them and equally spaced horizontal equipotentials. At the ends of the plates the field lines bow outwards and the equipotentials curve. In every sketch the field lines cross the equipotentials at right angles.

g.text: equal steps in V: gaps grow
uniform in the middle: equal gaps
